sources.sourceReview: All362 selected source images reviewed in source-only contact sheets before predictions. Ballet/bicycle edge fragments inspected in detail; their absence labels begin before full visual disappearance and end after partial return, so ambiguous boundaries remain uncertain. VOT bird1 is a real onboard flight camera with black borders, distinct from rendered OTB Bird1; its selected event is another active-image exit. Car1 enters behind a central vertical structure and returns; detailed source crops support four confidently hidden frames1533–1536, with19 NaN boundary frames uncertain. Bike1 first96 images remain visible. Bird1 stride2 with explicit interval endpoints gives78 sampled images and skips intervening frames. External boxes plus separate AI visibility/cause review, no independent human adjudication and no other-object geometry. Frozen scorer breaks recovery episodes at uncertainty; descriptive boundary return tables must not invent recovery timing across those gaps. Existing audit format requires every scored rectangle to have both normalized sides at least0.025. 14 visible small/clipped external boxes are therefore retained as uncertain/unscorable, never expanded or classified hidden. Original external rectangles remain intact; pre-format inputs retained in Git d84ccd12 and original evidence. Unsupported extra row metadata was removed; the same external finite/NaN distinction remains in row notes. Six score boxes and one seed meet the exact rational1/40 side bound but double subtraction rounded below it; a single outward endpoint ULP preserves the mathematically valid rectangle. No pixel-scale padding, relaxed bound or changed source image; each exact correction retained.

priorImageOverlap.scope: Exact JPEG-byte overlap against prior retained publication JSON image hashes; different encodings are not ruled out by byte identity alone. Source scenes were also visually compared.

limitations: Five bounded windows, not a full VOT benchmark or real-time camera validation.
One physical obstruction episode with four confidently hidden samples; three exits/re-entries and a visible-motion control.
Independent external rectangles/NaN data; AI source visibility is not independently human adjudicated.
No independent distractor boxes, so zero confirmed switches is not proof of identity continuity.
Preserved uncertain boundaries limit frozen scorer recovery-episode counts.
Official SHA1, CRC and uncompressed size match; listed compressed sizes differ from exact ZIP lengths.
